rationale: After achieving a 1.55% maximum favorable excursion, the downward momentum stalled well above the $28.48 session low and price has completely round-tripped back above both the entry price ($29.72) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($29.64). With the bid-ask spread widening to 47.1 bps and buyers stepping in across the last five 1-minute candles, exiting near breakeven preserves capital now that the short-term breakdown has failed to follow through.
